title: Mere bhai se mujhko milado
body:
Bain hai yeh Raza ki behen ka mere bhai se mujhko milado, Basti walo Payamber ka sadqa mere bhai se mujhko milado...
Mai janabe Raza ki behen hu Saiyyada hoon gharibul watan hoon, Rehem mujpar karo qasta tan hoon mere bhai se mujhko milado...
Chutke bhai se hoti hai muddat ek arse se dekhi na surat, Mujhpe Ahsaan tum sab ka hoga mere bhai se mujhko milado...
Kyun siya posh hai shehar sara kiske matam mein hai sar barehna, Qairiyat se toh hai bhai mera mere bhai se mujhko milado...
Aj har ghar mein kiski aza hai kuch sunao toh kya hadsa hai, Dil mera aj ghabra raha hai mere bhai se muihko milado...
Paas koi nahi qastatan ke sainkdo'n hai adu bewatan ke, Muntezar honge bhai behen ke mere bhai se mujhko milado.....
